title: CAST Routing Event
description: Schema for routing events logged to cast.db when agents are dispatched. Captures the dispatch decision metadata for observability.

session_id.description: Parent session ID that initiated the dispatch.

model.description: Model tier assigned to the agent.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the routing decision.

prompt_summary.description: Truncated summary of the prompt sent to the agent.

batch_id.description: Batch number when dispatched as part of an orchestrator plan.

isolation.description: Whether the agent ran in worktree isolation.
